If you want the **best online courses** for shadow work and spiritual practice, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s *Encounters with the Shadow*** for a more psychological/Jungian approach, **ManTalks’ *Shadow Course*** for a guided integration process, and **DailyOM’s *The Shadow Work Method to Heal*** for a more structured, beginner-friendly format.[4][15][16]

A practical way to choose is by style:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** (Jung Platform) | Deeper Jungian study | It is an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and is part of Jung Platform’s Jungian psychology offerings.[4][6][8] |
| **Shadow Course** (ManTalks) | Guided transformation | It offers an immersive 8-week guided process focused on fully facing and integrating the shadow.[15] |
| **The Shadow Work Method to Heal** (DailyOM) | Beginners | It is a compact course with 8 lessons, which makes it easier to start with.[16] |
| **Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self for Healing and Growth** (Insight Timer) | Meditation + healing | It combines shadow work with healing and growth, and has a strong user rating in the listing provided.[19] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self Certification** (Udemy) | Broad self-development | It explicitly emphasizes healing, integration, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[1] |

If your goal is specifically **shadow work plus spiritual practice**, the most relevant options are the ones that explicitly mention **spiritual transformation**, **awakening**, or **meditation/prayer/practices**. For that reason, **Udemy’s *Shadow Work Course and Workbook***, **Udemy’s *Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self Certification***, and **Insight Timer’s shadow work course** are especially aligned with spiritual practice.[11][1][19]

A simple recommendation by goal:

- **Most rigorous / psychologically grounded:** *Encounters with the Shadow*.[4][6][8]
- **Best guided program:** *Shadow Course* by ManTalks.[15]
- **Best for beginners:** *The Shadow Work Method to Heal* on DailyOM.[16]
- **Best for spiritual practice integration:** *Shadow Work Course and Workbook* on Udemy.[11]
- **Best for a meditative format:** *Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self for Healing and Growth* on Insight Timer.[19]

If you want, I can also narrow these down to the **best free options**, **best budget options**, or **best courses for beginners vs. advanced students**.
